IsNull.description_en: Whether the value is NULL. When true, it should be treated as NULL
IsNull.description_zh: 是否为 NULL；为 true 时应按 NULL 处理

description_en: Executes a read-only SQL statement to query internal EventHouse data within a specified time range. The time range only constrains the internal EventHouse data referenced in the SQL statement and does not affect mounted external data sources. Returns a structured result set
description_zh: 在指定时间范围内直接执行SQL语句查询内部事件仓数据。时间范围仅约束SQL中引用的内部EventHouse数据，挂载的外部数据源不受影响。返回结构化结果集
name: QueryEventHouseWithTimeRange

parameters.help_en: The single read-only SQL statement to execute. You can query internal EventHouse data or perform federated queries with mounted external data sources
parameters.help_zh: 要执行的单条只读SQL语句。支持查询内部EventHouse，也支持与挂载的外部数据源进行联合查询
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying internal EventHouse data. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time range includes this point in time
parameters.help_zh: 查询内部EventHouse数据的开始时间，使用Unix时间戳，单位为秒。时间区间包含该时刻
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying internal EventHouse data. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time range excludes this point in time. The value must be greater than BeginTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询内部EventHouse数据的结束时间，使用Unix时间戳，单位为秒。时间区间不包含该时刻，且必须大于BeginTime
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of result rows that can be returned for this query
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询允许返回的最大结果行数
parameters.name: limit

Code.description_en: The return code of the operation. Success indicates a successful call. Other values indicate specific error codes
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示调用成功，其他取值表示具体错误码

Data.description_en: The structured result data returned by the SQL query
Data.description_zh: SQL查询返回的结构化结果数据

Rows.description_en: The list of result rows returned by the SQL query
Rows.description_zh: 本次SQL查询返回的结果行列表

items.description_en: A single result row that contains the name, type, value, and null flag of each column in the row
items.description_zh: 单行查询结果，包含该行各列的名称、类型、值和空值标记

Total.description_en: The number of result rows actually returned by the query
Total.description_zh: 本次查询实际返回的结果行数

Message.description_en: A success message if the call succeeds, or a specific error message if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口调用成功时返回成功信息，调用失败时返回具体错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于问题排查

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 接口调用是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败
